```{r}

library(tidyverse)

 participant <- read.csv("~/Analysis frequent customes/DataSource/parcitipant.csv")
 user_stateid<- read.csv("~/Analysis frequent customes/DataSource/user_stateid.csv")
 
# 
participant$Begin_Date<- ymd(participant$Begin_Date)
participant$Exit_Date<- ymd(participant$Exit_Date)

participant_target<- participant %>% filter(Begin_Date>= as.Date("2017-07-01") & Exit_Date >= as.Date("2017-07-01"))

```

participant_target$Industry_1prior<- substr(participant_target$Industry_1prior,1,2)

participant_target<- subset(participant_target,select = -c(Low_income, English_Learner, Cross_Cultural, Dis_homemaker, Employment_Entry, UC_Status, School_Status_Entry, SSI_SSDI,Othe_Assistant, Homeless, Pre_vocational_Activities, ITA, Pell_Grant, Date_last_service, Recieve_needs_payments))


# WIB Convert

participant_target$WIB<- substr(participant_target$WIB, 1,2)

participant_target<- participant_target%>% group_by(State_id)%>% mutate(Times=n())

# Add age column
participant_target$Age<- floor(time_length(difftime(participant_target$Begin_Date, ymd(participant_target$DOB)), "years"))


## Count missing values by row
participant_target$na_count <- apply(is.na(participant_target), 1, sum)

participant_target<-left_join(participant_target,user_stateid, by=c('State_id'='stateid'))


## Set tartget group between 10 to 20 times enrollment
Frequent_div1<- participant_target %>%  filter(Times< 10)
Frequent_div2<- participant_target %>%  filter(Times>=10 & Times< 20)
Frequent_div3<- participant_target %>%  filter(Times >= 20)
Frequent_div0<- participant_target %>% filter(Times==1)

install.packages("jtools", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com/")

fit <- lm(Times ~ ., data = subset(individual,select = -c(State_id, DOB, Begin_Date, Exit_Date, username, Office, WIB ,  Industry_3prior, Industry_2prior, Industry_1prior, Long_term_Unemployment, MSFS, na_count )))



effect_plot(fit, pred = Education, interval = TRUE, plot.points = TRUE,jitter = .2)

effect_plot(fit, pred = Age, interval = TRUE, plot.points = TRUE,jitter = .2)
